shortDescription: The Dow Jones Index decreased 152 points or 0.29 percent on Monday to close at 52421 points.The decline was led by Caterpillar (-4.23%), Goldman Sachs (-3.99%) and Nvidia (-3.26%).On the upside, the strongest performers were Salesforce (4.73%), IBM (2.36%) and Alphabet (2.15%).

title: The Dow Jones Index Closes 0.29% Lower
